connector.name: Painspotter
connector.registryDescription: AI-analyzed startup opportunities from Reddit, Hacker News & Product Hunt, with commercial scores.
connector.summary: Hosted at painspotter.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.painspotter, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: PainSpotter API key (starts with psk_live_). Create one at https://painspotter.ai/account. Free tier can call get_overview and get_opportunity; Pro unlocks all tools.
